study_identification_part.si_4_title: Patterns of connectome variability in autism across five functional activation tasks: findings from the LEAP project

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) multisite dataset
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: “All analyses were based on the EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS multisite Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) ...”

answer.LEAP: TD controls used to build normative model; model applied to out-of-sample TD and autism participants for task-specific analyses

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative model built against age/sex from TD participants; used to predict (a)typical edge values in out-of-sample TD and autistic participants; done separately per task
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: “A normative model of potency edge values was built against age and sex from typically developing participants ... The model was used to predict the range of (a)typical edge values in out-of-sample typically developing participants as well as the autistic participants... This was done separately in each task.”

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: TD controls in LEAP reported as n=221 overall; no train/validation/test split reported for the normative model
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: “All analyses were based on the EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS multisite Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) with participants with autism ( n = 282) and typically developing (TD) controls ( n = 221) ...”

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age summary reported for TD controls overall; no train/validation/test split reported
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: “... 221 typically developing controls (age range 6.9-29.8 years; mean = 17.0; sd = 5.5; 63.8% male).”

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Male percent reported for TD controls; female count/pct inferred from total N=221 and 63.8% male
